checks.name: private-endpoint
checks.detail: actual AF_UNIX listener under own 0700 short directory; socket 0600

checks.name: private-bootstrap-subprocess
checks.detail: real stdio child; one-time 0600 bootstrap consumed/unlinked; no token in argv or child env

checks.name: stdio-to-broker-run-binding
checks.detail: initialize/tools-list/tools-call traversed real subprocess and AF_UNIX; actor derived in owner

checks.name: wrong-token
checks.detail: wrong bearer cannot access bound context

checks.name: no-caller-scope-switch
checks.detail: top-level and nested project spoof rejected before dispatch; no project parameter controls identity

checks.name: newline-framing
checks.detail: escaped LF round-trips through JSON; literal LF malformed frame rejected; later valid request succeeds

checks.name: request-and-response-budget
checks.detail: 1024-byte frame and 2048-byte result caps enforced on actual socket

checks.name: broker-write-policy
checks.detail: owner policy blocks write; OS read-only marker is not used as a business permission

checks.name: revision-recheck
checks.detail: existing stdio child denied on next request after current policy revision changes

checks.name: os-marker-is-not-write-isolation
checks.detail: synthetic policy-granted in-memory write succeeds despite marker; no real external write performed

checks.name: token-expiry
checks.detail: same running child loses access after owner expiry check

checks.name: run-revocation
checks.detail: owner revocation applies to existing child at next request

checks.name: child-eof-protocol-cleanup
checks.detail: all 3 children exit on stdin EOF; captured stdout is JSON-RPC; no token or diagnostics leaked

checks.name: owner-shutdown-cleanup
checks.detail: normal owner shutdown clears run tokens and listener/thread/socket/private directory

transport: stdio JSON-RPC subprocess -> private AF_UNIX -> synthetic owner broker
limits: Minimal MCP subset, not SDK conformance or real CLI acceptance
Python owner substitutes Electron main; no production bridge implemented
No OS-strong isolation between processes of the same UID
One request/connection; no concurrency/backpressure or crash-restart acceptance
OS read-only is a synthetic marker, not an OS sandbox test
